extension.summary: Multi-Provider WireGuard VPN Manager (Linux Desktop) (NordVPN, PIA, Custom, ProtonVPN)
extension.description: High-performance, hardened WireGuard VPN manager for Linux Desktop. Supports multiple providers including NordVPN (NordLynx), Private Internet Access (PIA), ProtonVPN via Custom Mode, and Custom configurations. Features an integrated watchdog thread with automatic interface and route recovery to prevent connection drops.[CR][CR][B]Note:[/B] Designed specifically for Linux Desktop. [CR][CR][B]Features:[/B][CR]• Multi-Provider Support (Nord, PIA, Custom)[CR]• Pure Python WireGuard Handshake logic[CR]• Smart Watchdog & Auto-Reconnect[CR]• Hardened DNS & IPv6 Leak Protection[CR][CR][B]Disclaimer:[/B] Not an official product of any VPN provider. Use at your own risk.
extension.news:
v1.0.7 (2026-09-24)
- Selective routing (per-user VPN enforcement): optionally route only the Kodi user through the tunnel while all other processes (other users, system services, containers) stay on the default route. Installed via a one-time pkexec elevation prompt on first run. Survives profile regeneration and watchdog reconnects. See wiki: Installation & Setup, section 5. - Note: with the firewall killswitch enabled, non-tunneled outbound traffic may still be blocked at the iptables level - this is expected behavior of the killswitch, not the routing feature. Disable the killswitch if other processes need direct internet access. - Setup integrity check now runs once per add-on version: after updating, first start verifies your existing setup and fills in missing components (declining the elevation prompt stays permanent until cleanup/reset). - Minor: stable reconnect profile resolution, NM delete handling hardened.
